tasks.title: Implement category_report using domainlib pipeline and output
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's category_report function is not yet implemented. It should load CSV records using domainlib.pipeline.load_records, count occurrences of each value in the given category field using domainlib.pipeline.aggregate, and format the result as a text table using domainlib.output.format_table with the title 'Category Report'.
tasks.test_context: test_category_report_by_dept, test_category_report_by_name, and test_category_report_empty_csv fail with NotImplementedError because category_report has no implementation.

tasks.title: Implement filtered_category_report with filter and aggregate pipeline
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's filtered_category_report function is not yet implemented. It should load records, filter them by a given field/value using domainlib.pipeline.filter_records, aggregate the filtered results by category using domainlib.pipeline.aggregate, and format with domainlib.output.format_table titled 'Filtered Report'.
tasks.test_context: test_filtered_category_report_eng_names, test_filtered_category_report_sales_names, test_filtered_category_report_no_match, and test_filtered_category_report_case_insensitive fail with NotImplementedError.

tasks.title: Implement total_summary using sum_field and format_summary
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's total_summary function is not yet implemented. It should load CSV records, compute the sum of a numeric field using domainlib.aggregation.sum_field, and format a summary line using domainlib.output.format_summary with the total, record count, and average.
tasks.test_context: test_total_summary and test_total_summary_empty_csv fail with NotImplementedError because total_summary has no implementation.

tasks.title: Implement filtered_summary with filter, sum, and format pipeline
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's filtered_summary function is not yet implemented. It should load records, filter by field/value, compute the sum of a numeric field on the filtered set, and format a summary line with total, count, and average.
tasks.test_context: test_filtered_summary_eng, test_filtered_summary_sales, test_filtered_summary_no_match, and test_filtered_summary_case_insensitive fail with NotImplementedError.

tasks.title: Implement grouped_totals using group_by and sum_field
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's grouped_totals function is not yet implemented. It should load records, group them by a field using domainlib.aggregation.group_by, compute sum_field for each group, and format the totals as a table using domainlib.output.format_table titled 'Group Totals'.
tasks.test_context: test_grouped_totals_by_dept, test_grouped_totals_empty_csv, and test_grouped_totals_by_name fail with NotImplementedError because grouped_totals has no implementation.

tasks.title: Implement grouped_summaries with group_by, sum_field, and format_summary
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's grouped_summaries function is not yet implemented. It should load records, group by a field, then for each group (sorted alphabetically) compute the sum and format a summary line. All lines are joined with newlines.
tasks.test_context: test_grouped_summaries_by_dept, test_grouped_summaries_empty_csv, and test_grouped_summaries_single_group fail with NotImplementedError because grouped_summaries has no implementation.

tasks.title: Implement both report functions in reports.py
tasks.problem_statement: Both category_report and filtered_category_report in the consumer's reports module are not yet implemented. category_report should load records and aggregate by category field. filtered_category_report should additionally filter records before aggregating. Both format results using format_table.

tasks.title: Implement both summary functions in summaries.py
tasks.problem_statement: Both total_summary and filtered_summary in the consumer's summaries module are not yet implemented. total_summary should load records, sum a field, and format a summary. filtered_summary should filter first, then sum and format. Both use format_summary for output.
tasks.test_context: All tests in test_summaries.py fail with NotImplementedError because both total_summary and filtered_summary are stubs.

tasks.title: Implement both export functions in exports.py
tasks.problem_statement: Both grouped_totals and grouped_summaries in the consumer's exports module are not yet implemented. grouped_totals should group records and sum a field per group, formatting as a table. grouped_summaries should produce per-group summary lines sorted alphabetically.
tasks.test_context: All tests in test_exports.py fail with NotImplementedError because both grouped_totals and grouped_summaries are stubs.

tasks.title: Implement category_report, total_summary, and grouped_totals across three files
tasks.problem_statement: Three consumer functions across different modules are not yet implemented: category_report in reports.py (load, aggregate, format_table), total_summary in summaries.py (load, sum_field, format_summary), and grouped_totals in exports.py (load, group_by, sum per group, format_table). Each composes domainlib functions following the documented pipeline patterns.
